thread_text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a nightly soak on staging this Thursday 02:00 UTC. Goal: 6h soak that combines a k6 steady-state ramp -> locust scenario storm -> traffic replay. Need preflight checklist, smoke gates, and who can monitor. Primary checks: p99 latency, error rate, OOMs. :rocket:

liam: I can monitor. Can we run a small dry-run tonight to validate infra and scripts? Also need the replay id + dataset size so I can estimate generator nodes.

anita: I will own the traffic replay recording and upload. Replay ID: replay-2026-03-14. Files are at s3://redwood-replays/staging/replay-2026-03-14.tar.gz — stripped tokens and safe to run. Dataset ~120k requests (mixed).

sam: Quick ops note — k6 is good for steady-state and cpu patterns, locust for complex user flows. Suggest sequence: 30m k6 ramp to target RPS, 4.5h locust distributed scenarios, last 1h run replay against live routing for cache warm/cold behavior.

perf-bot: Perf-bot: baseline snapshot loaded (id: base-1765000000). Reference p50/p95/p99 available in the dashboard. Will auto-compare after run.

devops: I'll provision ephemeral load pool: 8 instances (g4dn.xlarge) with autoscaling min=4,max=12. Terraform plan posted: https://ci.internal/terraform/plan/8234 — will also request quota bump now. Egress IP range: 34.72.16.0/24.

maya: Smoke gate proposal: pass if (1) p99 text-gen endpoints < 300ms, (2) overall error rate < 0.5%, (3) zero container OOMs, (4) no >5% increase in retry rate vs baseline. If any fail -> auto-cancel and rollback generators. :warning:

liam: How should we implement auto-cancel? Jenkins job can check metrics via perf API and abort. I can add a watcher that hits /perf/v1/metrics and cancels the k8s job if thresholds breached.

anita: CMD for the k6 smoke-run (dockerized) — will run as part of the preflight job:

```bash
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/k6-scripts:/scripts loadimpact/k6 run /scripts/smoke.js --vus 50 --duration 10m --out influxdb=httppost://perf-db:8086/k6
```

sam: For distributed locust we'll use the headless mode + 12 workers. Example launch: `locust -f tests/flow.py --headless -u 4000 -r 200 --run-time 4h30m --host https://staging.api.redwood.ai` — logs to s3 via sidecar. Also enable `--csv` for quick summaries.

maya: Monitoring and alerting: create a dedicated dashboard with p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization, queue depth, and KV cache hit ratio. Post alerts into #eng-runtime-incidents and tag @oncall. Who can be primary?

liam: I'll take primary for the first 2 hours. @anita can be secondary for replay/record issues. I will also run flamegraphs if we see latency spikes.

anita: I'll upload generator logs and replay metadata to s3://redwood-load-logs/nightly-soak/1765231111/ after the run. Also will gather heap profiles every hour via the profiler endpoint and put into the same path.

perf-bot: Perf-bot: will run postmortem comparison step and comment on this thread with a pass/fail and attachments (CSV diffs, graphs). If regressions detected, will tag the rollout owner.

maya: Plan: dry-run tonight 20:00 UTC (short 30m end-to-end, low RPS). If green -> full soak Thu 02:00 UTC. Please add any blockers now. Thanks! :thumbsup:
